max_steps=50
steps=0
while steps<max_steps:
    cur=apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    priv=apis.spotify.show_song_privates(song_id=cur['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
    print('step',steps,'song',cur['title'],'id',cur['song_id'],'liked',priv['liked'])
    if priv['liked']:
        break
    res=apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print('previous_song:',res)
    steps+=1

print('stopped at steps',steps)
cur=apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
priv=apis.spotify.show_song_privates(song_id=cur['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
print('final:',cur['title'],cur['song_id'],'liked',priv['liked'])
